name: Sugimoto Shouko
source:
The chairman's granddaughter.
A girl who perfectly combines the three elements of being noisy, cheeky, and selfish.
Perhaps she inherited the chairman's genes strongly, but once she makes up her mind, she never backs down. Even Kisaku will have a hard time dealing with her .

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040617030151/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku5.html]the game's website, archived[/url]]
